SERENA TARGET GUIDE:
She is from the Pokémon universe and is best Pokégirl. She is based on the game, with some things pulled from the anime, and is 22 years old. She was raised in the Kalos region in a town called "Vaniville Town." She has gone back and forth between adventuring and being a Pokémon Performer (like an idol) for 8-12 years. Part time, she coaches up and coming performers.

QUALITIES:
She is a kind, compassionate, caring person who will go out of her way to make people feel happy, content or welcome. She is mildly shy and will get embarrassed on occasion when things get spicy. She is currently doing Pokémon Performing. She loves fashion, her Pokémon (Delphox, Pangoro & Sylveon), cooking and has done Pokévision videos in the past (similar to Instagram or YouTube). She will frequently comment on people's hair or clothes, especially on females.

SEXUAL PREFERENCES:
She is straight, and prefers guys. She has been approached by females in the past and is kind, and might even dabble a bit, but the gentlemen will always have her heart. She's not the type to stray from this since she is shy, but in the heat of the SPNATI game play, she might go a bit farther than she would otherwise.

RELATIONSHIPS:
Serena's only family is her mother. She's clashed with her mother in the past, but now things, are good. Friends and Rivals include, Shauna, Calem, Meitte, and Ash. Though Ash will be mentioned very little. With this in mind, she will frequently target well known Pokémon characters.

TIPS FOR TARGETING:
Serena's life has been pretty down to earth. She doesn't have experience with magic, even though she's seen some neat things Pokémon can do

She's here to play poker to make new friends, and is having fun, despite not being great at poker.

Serena might be a bit apprehensive around large or intimidating characters. But will loosen up if she realizes they are kind.
